Hello! I really liked the drawing you did of me and my partner's characters, CARABELLE and IRENE!
https://skeb.jp/@UIIU04/works/6
It's my favorite picture of them and I am so grateful! If possible, could I ask you to draw our other characters? Please feel free to reject or raise the price, since five characters is a lot!

https://imgur.com/a/QF98bZj

They are a group of college students in a fantasy-like setting.
- JAIME (172cm) is the green character. She is friendly, fashionable, and popular.
- CELEUXE (165cm) is the red character. He is hot-headed, reckless, and likes to act like the leader.
- YUMENO (157cm) is the pink character. She still acts like a 中二病, but is nervous in public.
- DIOE (152cm) is the yellow character. They dislike talking, but try to be polite.
- LISZA (170cm) is the blue character. She is awkward around others, but can be playful when she feels comfortable.

All five of them are very close. Please draw however you'd like! Thank you for your consideration!

UI様、はじめまして！イラストを楽しく拝見させて頂きました。素敵な絵柄に惹かれて、可能ならば自キャラを依頼したいと思っております。

【依頼内容】
キャラ参照は下記のURLをご覧ください。南東アジアの様なトロピカル島国に旅をしていて、凸凹コンビで喧嘩すればするほど仲がいい、親友家族恋人相棒のお2人です。一緒に未知か禁じられた廃墟や遺跡を探索している、所謂トゥームレイダーの様な存在です。褐色肌の子は楽天家でお喋り、髪の内側は宇宙の様に光っている。黒髪の子は不器用でクールな性格。対照的な2人ですが、一蓮托生の仲です。

【テーマ】
・可能ならば、2人をこちらの衣装を着せてください：https://sta.sh/2cqz4wti4y7
➤ 青い鞄と紫のショールが付いている方をお願い致します。黒髪の子の髪は右に流している。
➤ このURL先のモチーフや小物を入れても大丈夫です：https://sta.sh/23auuzaquab

・カラフルで可愛くて、楽しい雰囲気の一枚をお願い致します。
・「夏、お菓子とお茶、モザイクタイル、ヴィンテージ切手、骨董品、太陽と月、民族風」のモチーフをどちらでもご自由に使って大丈夫です。
・ポーズや構図は他は何でも構いませんので、お気軽に描いてください！

依頼内容に何か難しい点か問題点があれば、お気になさらずこの依頼をキャンセルしてください。ご検討のほど、何卒よろしくお願いします。

https://sta.sh/2cqz4wti4y7

HELLO!
😍Your art is incredible!
The colors are so pretty! Everything is so fun! 
Your art makes me so happy!🥰
I would be so happy if I can request a picture!

Can you please draw my character?
🖤His name is クロニ

He is an oni!
Once a superhero who fought evil!
However, they were devoured & eaten alive by ヤマタノオロチ.
Hundreds of years later he escaped. The incident was so traumatic it changed him.
Filled with anger & sorrow, he is now a supervillain!
He has many scars now. Tail & one horn damaged too.

He is also a Visual-Kei musician.🎤
He channels his hatred & need for revenge into music.
The concerts have a horror theme to them! Channeling the forces of hell into his musical theater!
A love for gothic & dark imagery!💀🥀
When he isn't performing a concert, he tends to be brooding & melancholic.

He has different outfits. You can choose the one you want to draw! Or design one for him.
The pose, expression, & everything I leave up to you!
I hope you can have fun with it!😄

Thank you!🌹

https://catbox.moe/c/k6soi6

Hello! Your art style is so pretty! Would it be possible for me to request these two characters to be drawn together?

CARABELLE is on the left. She is very sociable and stylish, always being recognized because she is a popular fashion designer. She is often tipsy because she drinks alcohol in order to get inspiration.

IRENE is on the right. She is more serious and strict. She worked as a child actor and now dislikes a lot of the attention. Still, when she's around some of her closer friends (like CARABELLE), she lets herself smile and be a little lighter.

The two of them are close partners both on and off of work. They run the public relations division for their company. They can be drawn with alcohol, ice cream, coffee, or with newspapers and reports. These are just suggestions, please draw them however you would like! Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1YveyxZwQS9v9p5zU_58UzX8RMOiVv1TO/view?usp=sharing
